verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government agency with an information portal, and such bodies can plausibly publish open-data or service APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only informational content (migration, integration, asylum statistics, service teams). It never mentions an API, OpenAPI spec or any other machine-readable interface description.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
